before.meaningZh: 貓；（舊式貶義名詞）惡意說閒話的人
before.meaningEn: (n.) a domestic cat or another animal of the cat family; (dated, derogatory noun) a malicious gossip. Other source uses are separate: cat as a British slang verb means to vomit; the uppercase abbreviation CAT can mean computer-aided teaching. These do not expand this learner headword’s existing noun POS.
